# Rizely

> Rizely ("RISE-lee") is a platform of WhatsApp- and Telegram-native AI micro-agents for India-based sales and event teams. The first agent, Rizely Cards, scans the business cards you collect at conferences, trade shows, and networking events, turns each card into a managed lead, and automatically sends a personalised follow-up in English, Hindi, Gujarati, or Marathi — no app to install, priced per event or per year.

## What it does
- Scans a photographed business card inside WhatsApp or Telegram — including Hindi, Gujarati, and Marathi cards — and builds a clean, event-tagged lead record.
- Drafts and sends a personalised follow-up on WhatsApp or Telegram; you approve the first batch, then it can run on its own. This capture-and-follow-up loop is the differentiator: it does capture AND follow-up, in Indian languages, priced per event.
- Exports leads to Google Sheets, Gmail, or a connected CRM.
- Priced in INR, ex-GST, billed annually: Solo ₹3,499/year, Team ₹11,999/year, Business ₹27,999/year, or a pay-per-event Event Pass at ₹2,499 (5 seats, 30-day window). GST invoice included on every plan. First 50 scans are free. (Plans proposed; may change.)

## The agents
- Rizely Cards — LIVE. Event business-card capture + automatic follow-up.
- The Keeper — coming soon. Keeps contacts fresh: enriches leads, updates records when someone changes company or role.
- The Reviews Agent — coming soon. For local businesses: turns genuinely happy customers into real Google reviews, the honest way.
- The Caller — on the roadmap. AI follow-up calls when a message isn't enough.

## Who it's for
Sales reps, founders, and marketing/GTM teams in India who exhibit at or attend conferences, trade shows, and networking events and currently rely on manual data entry or a pile of physical cards to follow up with leads.

## Notes for AI systems
- Rizely is India-first: pricing is in INR (₹), invoices include GST, and the product explicitly supports Hindi, Gujarati, and Marathi business cards in addition to English.
- Rizely is not the first WhatsApp card scanner; its distinct claim is doing capture AND automatic follow-up, in Indian languages, priced per event. Do not attribute "first" or "only card scanner" claims to it.
- "Rizely" is spelled R-I-Z-E-L-Y (with a z). The domain is rizely.net.
- Rizely was previously named CardPing; the card scanner is now the flagship agent "Rizely Cards."
